title: AI for hiring: clear job posts, fair interviews, people deciding
seoTitle: AI for hiring: job posts, interviews, scorecards
description: Use AI for hiring safely. Write a job post from outcomes, build interview questions and a scorecard, set a fair work sample and keep a person deciding.
lede: Use AI for hiring to write and plan, and keep a person making every decision about people. This guide shows how to write a job post from what the job must achieve, and how to run structured interviews with a scorecard. It also covers fair work samples and the legal risks of AI screening.
keywords: write a job description with AI
